note: City of Evansdale campground on a peninsula along the Cedar River, just off I-380/US-20 exit 70, with tent sites, two rentable shelters, playgrounds, a beach house, an 18-hole disc golf course and a Cedar River boat ramp for kayaking, fishing and tubing. --Claude
summary: Confirmed rates (2026: $25 electric/water, $30 full, $20 non-electric; weekly, monthly, seasonal), cash only. Showers confirmed; cleared note-derived 156-site count, dump and season (no city page states them). Waterfront LEAD: a ~13-acre lake beside the east row, open grass between. Note's 'continuous treeline' claim dropped as contradicted.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD (up, for AWH): an unnamed lake lies on the campground's east side. On NAIP it is roughly 13 acres (~5 ha, irregular, well over the 5-acre line) and algae-green. The east row of about 20 sites (on the east side of the campground road, roughly 42.4585-42.4605, -92.3065 to -92.3060) backs onto open mown grass about 15-30 m wide to the lake's west shore. A narrow light strip, 4-7 m wide (sand or a path; a beach house is mentioned nearby, so it could be a swim beach), runs along that shore. No road or treeline is between these sites and the water. The north end of the row has trees between. If the strip is only a path, that row reads as lakefront; if it is the beach, it is day use, so lakeview at best. The city's pages don't name or describe the lake and Overpass was down, so the strip is unidentified. Per the unsure rule the value stays not waterfront unless AWH confirms. The stored note's 'Pads sit behind a continuous treeline screening them from the river and backwater' is true only on the river side, so I dropped it.
RIVER: the Cedar here is about 110-130 m wide (riverfront-sized). The west rows sit 60-100 m from it behind the bank's continuous treeline, so not riverfront and no clear view.
LONG-STAY (local, for information): monthly $400 and seasonal $1800 offered. On imagery most sites hold parked trailers in midsummer, but daily rates are posted. Not a drop on its own.
CLEARED: sites.count 156, facilities.dump, season.year_round false (note prose; the city page states none of them).
FIT OK: back-in gravel sites holding fifth wheels and Class A coaches on imagery.
PIN: 42.45950,-92.30650 is on the lake-shore grass at the east row, about 170 m from the campground's centre (~42.4600,-92.3085). Under 250 m, so no change is needed.
